verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to export TOTP secrets in an open, readable format. Cloud Backup only restores accounts into Authenticator on a new device, and Export Passwords covers autofill passwords, not TOTP seeds, so both are adjacent features that earn no credit. Community comments suggesting users switch to other apps such as Aegis do not show any export path from Authenticator.

support.subject: As a power user, I can export all my TOTP secrets in an open, readable format and leave for another app whenever I choose — no lock-in
